title: Fish Farming in Pre-modern China: A Study and Translation of Two Texts
lineage: Original textual analysis and translation of surviving witnesses to historical fish farming; contextual comparison to Nakajima et al. cites their own dataset.

passages.note: Traces the fish farming text attributed to Fan Li, whose earliest transmitted version survives in the sixth-century CE Qimin yaoshu. The attribution and the title in a later catalogue do not date the work to the historical Fan Li.
